The owner was able to beat any other quote I received from other companies! Very affordable and easy to work with. I wanted something a little more modern and had a small backyard to work with and he nailed it! I loved his ideas about the different types of pool lights, and the fire pit on top of waterfall. Everything was exactly what I was looking for and I was included in every step of the process. Great quality pool, my friends and family love it! Also he beat the timeline I wanted as well! I was swimming within 2 months of construction start! Grace Litman I recommend Paradise Pools I work with Matt and he was responsive. I could call him, or send a text. If he didn’t answer my call, he’d call me back in like a few minutes. He respond to all the text messages, almost too quickly.. it was Easter Sunday, and he was reaching out, asking how it’s looking. He went above and beyond, he was exceptional. We needed to replace some pipes, I said to replace the minimum that needed to be replaced, and in the end, they replaced every single pipe because it was gonna look better, and charged me nothing extra. He was easy, and straight to the point. He really look out for what was best for us, I wanted to do a modification to my spa, even though it was a costly project, he said it was not necessary, and was very honest. I would totally work with them again. Christopher Duran The team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, delivering a high-quality pool within the agreed timeframe. data.summary: The Google reviews are highly suspicious duplicates with generic praise, while Yelp contains credible, detailed complaints about taking deposits and not performing work. This pattern suggests potential review manipulation on Google and serious business practice issues.
fake_signals: Google reviews are verbatim duplicates between Local and HQ pages
All Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Generic, corporate-sounding language in Google reviews
Lack of specific project details in Google reviews
No reviews on other major platforms (Angi, Houzz, Trustpilot)

negative_evidence: Yelp reviews indicate failure to start work after deposit, suggesting no follow-through on contractual obligations

authentic_signals: Yelp reviews contain specific details (deposit amounts, contract dates, communication attempts)
Yelp reviews show varied writing styles and emotional authenticity
BBB profile shows 6 years in business with a founding date
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extreme discrepancy between perfect 5.0 Google rating (4 reviews) and poor 2.3 Yelp rating (3 reviews). The Google reviews are generic and duplicated, while Yelp reviews contain specific, credible complaints.
